evaluation_environment.host: Codex desktop delegated task, functions.exec shell orchestration
evaluation_environment.model: Inherited Codex evaluator; exact model identifier and build not exposed

methodology.selection: Read 23 SKILL frontmatter descriptions; independently authored 69 realistic requests and selected the appropriate skill semantically. tests/routing/prompts.json and its expected fields were not read. This is subagent task routing, not Desktop UI skill discovery or autoload evidence.
methodology.bias: Requests were authored by this evaluator after reading the skill inventory, so this is a forward usability sample, not blinded classification accuracy. No accuracy percentage is claimed.
methodology.explicit: Read SKILL entries and relevant native/execution/evidence guidance; execute copied representative assets under named $skill task context.
methodology.natural: Make semantic route selections first, then load selected skills and execute 23 fresh representative tasks without a $skill token in the task requests. Modify/diagnose requests add semantic selection evidence; fixture assertions may exercise those behaviors but those 46 requests were not separately implemented.
methodology.runtime: Inspect structured report, complete engine log, exit code, output files and environment blocks. Restricted failures remain in historical_attempts.
methodology.isolation: All processes use task-created project copies and artifact outputs. Implementation sources were not edited by evaluator. Authoring-only Python orchestrates evidence; it is not a plugin runtime dependency.
methodology.portable_paths: PLUGIN represents the absolute workspace root used in original execution records; arguments, exits, assertions and source hashes are preserved. Raw unredacted logs remain in ignored artifacts.

explicit_invocations.request: $godot-2d: Create a three-cell Godot terrain strip with matching sides and verify saved cells and world-to-map coordinates.
$godot-3d: Build a Godot 3D scene with a box, camera and sun, independently resize a second mesh and verify saved dimensions.
$godot-animation: Create a position animation library in Godot, evaluate its midpoint and reload its stored track and keyframes.
$godot-api: Verify public Godot bindings for tile layers and navigation baking, then prove scene pack/save ownership through a minimal actual call.
$godot-architecture: Create a Godot module with an injected service and command/fact signals; verify readiness, repeated wiring, replacement and teardown.
$godot-assets: Generate a Godot texture, import it, change its source width and reimport, then recover a missing source and verify glTF bounds.
$godot-audio: Generate a short mono Godot WAV, route a player through a limited bus, save/read back routing and exercise mute/unmute and completion.
$godot-csharp: Build a Godot C# Resource with clamped Score and generated ScoreChanged signal, then verify method calls and uncached save/readback.
$godot-data: Implement and verify versioned Godot save migration, guarded commit, backup readback and recovery while preserving corrupt/future files.
$godot-editor-tools: Implement a Godot editor dock that adds an owned marker through undo/redo, saves/reloads the scene and survives repeated disable/enable.
$godot-export: Create a Windows Godot export preset, import a tiny project, build with existing matching templates and launch the actual exported executable.
$godot-gdextension: Build and load a native Godot Resource exposing score, add and score_changed, and verify clamping and saved independent readback.
$godot-gdscript: Implement a typed Godot counter with signal delivery and asynchronous continuation; verify reconnect and disconnect behavior.
$godot-multiplayer: Create a local Godot server and clients with spawning, replication and RPC; reject invalid authority/bounds and verify disconnect and reconnect.

report.scope: loopback: server + 2 clients + reconnect, authoritative bounds/ownership/budget rejection, spawn, property replication, RPC, disconnect

explicit_invocations.request: $godot-navigation: Bake Godot navigation, save it and verify paths across two regions and rejection of excluded or disabled destinations.
$godot-performance: Benchmark distance versus squared-distance radius queries over a fixed 512-actor snapshot with warmup, distributions and behavior equivalence.

benchmark.timing_scope: CPU GDScript query only; excludes scene initialization, rendering and snapshot construction
benchmark.workload: radius query over static 512-actor position snapshot

explicit_invocations.request: $godot-physics: Create a Godot character that lands on a floor, moves at units per second, raycasts with masks and crosses a trigger exactly once.
$godot-project: Create a Godot project configuration with persistent jump input and Session Autoload, then launch it and verify bootstrap state.
$godot-rendering: Create a Godot canvas shader material, save its tint and verify actual GPU pixels before and after an isolated uniform change.
$godot-scenes: Create a Godot packed scene with an owned child and persistent signal; verify reload executes the signal and excludes an unowned preview.
$godot-ui: Build a Godot menu with inherited Theme, local override readback, focused-button input and an overlay that blocks then permits clicks.
$godot-validation: Create bounded Godot checks detecting parse errors, runtime faults, errors with exit zero, timeout and missing reports, while rejecting unrelated failures.
$godot-workflow: Build and verify a complete Godot 2D loop with start, movement/collision, collection, win, save/readback and keyboard restart.
